message.content:
Set up a Python virtual environment for the black library at /app/black/.venv and install all dependencies. Steps:
1. Create the venv: python3 -m venv /app/black/.venv
2. Install the library: /app/black/.venv/bin/pip install -e "/app/black[d]"
3. Install atheris: /app/black/.venv/bin/pip install atheris
4. Verify: /app/black/.venv/bin/python -c "import black; import atheris; print('black venv OK')"
